title: Lizardcraft
description: Mod collection for a private non commercial Minecraft Server
body:
# Enhanced Minecraft Adventure – Performance, QoL & Exploration

This modpack is designed to improve your Minecraft experience by combining performance optimizations, quality-of-life features, and new dimensions for exploration. It offers smoother gameplay, improved visuals, and expanded content without straying too far from the vanilla feel.

### What’s inside?

- Performance Boost: Mods like Sodium, Lithium, and Iris ensure high FPS and shader support.

- Visual Enhancements: Stunning shaders (Complementary Shaders), dynamic lighting (LambDynamicLights), and realistic skins (3D Skin Layers).

- Quality of Life: Features like Xaero's Minimap, FallingTree, and Veinminer make survival more intuitive and less grindy.

- New Dimensions & Biomes: Explore additional worlds such as the Aether and enhanced Nether/End with mods like BetterNether.

If you want a smooth, beautiful, and content-rich Minecraft experience without sacrificing performance, this modpack is perfect for you. It’s crafted for players who enjoy exploration, building, and an enhanced vanilla feel.

### Important Info:

Minecraft Version: 1.21.1 (NeoForge)

Shader support included (Iris + Complementary Shaders)

Designed for private multiplayer servers, but works in single-player too.
